name: Provenza Residences
overview: Provenza Residences by IKR Real Estate Development is a masterfully designed residential project in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai. Inspired by French elegance, the development merges classical European aesthetics with modern comforts and smart home features. Offering studios to 2-bedroom apartments, Provenza Residences provides a luxurious yet practical lifestyle with prices starting at AED 650,000. The community’s architecture, developed by a renowned French architect, introduces Provençal charm to the heart of Dubai, creating a perfect sanctuary for urban professionals, families, and savvy investors.
